title: Abarinzi b'Ubusitani
intro: Mu busitani bwiza cyane, umuryango umwe warasezeranye cyane. Ariko icyemezo cyabo cyageragejwe ubwo ubushake bw'Imana bwagira icyo bukora, buhindura impano yabo igihugu cy'ubutayu.
clues: Twahawe umugisha wo kugira ubusitani bwiza cyane, ariko twatangiye kwishyira hejuru.
Twafashe gahunda yo gusarura nta gusangira n'abakene.
Twatangiye urugendo kare mu gitondo, twizeye neza gahunda yacu.
Ariko tuhageze, twasanze ubusitani bwacu bwarangiritse mu ijoro rimwe.
Twabonye ikosa ryacu maze dutangira gushinjana amakosa.
Amaherezo twihannye, ariko isomo twaryigiyemo ryatinze.
arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
